name: Luciano Darderi
intro: Luciano Darderi plays for Italy, but he was born in Argentina. He is 24 and has five titles, all on clay courts. His dad is his coach.
story: Luciano began tennis at age four with his dad. His grandma Elisa gave him his first racket. Later he moved to Italy to chase his dream. This spring he beat the star Alexander Zverev in Rome. He was one point from losing four times, and still won!

funFacts.text: He was born on Valentine's Day.
He speaks Spanish, Italian, and English.
His favorite food is barbecue. His favorite treat is chocolate.
His favorite athlete is soccer star Lionel Messi.
His little brother Vito was a kids' tennis champ in Italy.
His grandma's name is tattooed on his right wrist.

watchFor: Watch him kiss the tattoo on his right wrist after big points.
